class: I-Aleph (Pe-Aleph, quiescent: אבד, אבה, אכל, אמר, אפה) — full grid: the 14 Qal squares that differ, plus every other square filled on א-כ-ל
rootNote: Teaching root אָכַל (tutor ruling 2026-11-21 4:09 PM ET). It is the root GKC Paradigm I, Davidson §35 and K&J print, it is regular (wayyiqtol וַיֹּאכַל with pataḥ, pausal ṣere יֹאכֵל), and it attests the same 12 of 14 squares as אמר. אָמַר keeps its attested forms where they matter: וַיֹּאמֶר is the wayyiqtol alternate (attested example from אמר) and לֵאמֹר is a note on the infinitive construct square.
source: GKC §68 and Paradigm I (PDF pp. 480-481); Davidson §35 p. 171; OSHB/WLC; STEPBible TAHOT. Filled squares: weak-iguttural.json (Qal qatal, imperative fs/mp, infinitive absolute, participles; Niphal, Hiphil, Hophal) and strong-verb.json (Piel, Pual, Hitpael), applied to א-כ-ל (Chairman's approval 2026-11-25 11:17 PM ET, relayed by Derek)
verificationMethod: Each form was matched (consonants + vowel points, accents ignored, dagesh lene and plene/defective ḥolem, shureq and ḥireq-yod spellings normalized) against OSHB morphhb-wlc tokens with the same OSHB morph slot. R1 is the literal quiescent א; R2/R3 positional; a begadkefat radical's dagesh in dagesh-lene position is optional; Hitpael is matched both with and without sibilant metathesis (הִשְׁתַּ- / הִתְ-). The example's root (with shin/sin dot) was checked against the Strong's headword for its lemma number. Example roots: only אבד (H6), אכל (H398), אמר (H559); אבה and אפה are also III-He and never examples. Ketiv excluded. Infinitives construct may carry a preposition (examplePrefix). Example preference: teaching root, then אמר/אבד; each in order no prefix, ו, preposition. Every matched token was cross-checked against STEPBible TAHOT; tokens where TAHOT disagrees are never used as examples. Filled squares (2026-11-25): matched with the verify_igut.py matcher (R1 = א, R2/R3 positional; R2 not guttural/ר/ו/י; R3 not א/ה/ח/ע/ו/י (נ and ר allowed, exact vowel match only); R2≠R3; Strong's headword must equal the matched radicals). Example roots: any I-Aleph root (אבה and אפה excluded as III-He); preference: אכל, then another I-Aleph root; each in order no prefix, ו, preposition. Same TAHOT rule. No token of the I-Guttural or strong-verb teaching roots is ever an example.

notes.scope: Full grid on א-כ-ל. 14 Qal squares are the original I-Aleph cells (unchanged). Every other square is filled: the former sameAsIGuttural squares with the I-Guttural pattern, Piel/Pual/Hitpael with the strong pattern (sourceRef says which).
notes.fiveVerbs: GKC §68.1: אָבַד, אָבָה, אָכַל, אָמַר, אָפָה. אבה and אפה are also III-He, so they are never used as examples here. Other I-Aleph verbs (אסף, אחז, אהב) quiesce only sometimes (יֹאסֵף/יֶאֱסֹף, יֹאחֵז/יֶאֱחֹז) and are not examples.
notes.cohortative: Cohortative 1cs אֹכְלָה (Davidson p. 171), אֹמְרָה. Note only.
notes.weqatal: Qal וְאָכַלְתָּ (Deut 8:10). Shown as a note, not a column.
notes.Hiphil jussive: Hiphil jussive 3ms יַאֲכֵל differs from yiqtol יַאֲכִיל; it has its own square.
